Kohlpharma
is a German pharmaceutical re-importer and
does not make continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, or wearable health tech
. Consumer smartwatches claiming non-invasive blood glucose or ECG tracking from the wrist offer generalized wellness trends rather than medical-grade clinical data
Wearable Health Tech Options
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Medical devices like the
Dexcom G7
or Abbott FreeStyle Libre use tiny subcutaneous filaments to measure interstitial glucose in real time.
PubMed Central (PMC) (.gov)
Smartwatches & ECG:
Consumer smartwatches can record single-lead ECGs and spot-check heart rates or blood oxygen, but they cannot reliably replace invasive or continuous blood sugar monitors.
GoodRx
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Involves syncing medical-grade data from devices (like CGMs) directly to healthcare providers.
